_comment: Coverage and dispatch map for the current production tree. Inventory definitions are durable; status-like fields in entries preserve historical coverage context and are not rollout state. Use ledger.json for current status. Execution results and JIT evidence are maintained in per-unit logs and migration_feedback_tracker.md.
mapping_rules: Run one compile-focused parameter before the complete mapped inventory.
A passing operation test counts as kernel coverage only when JIT evidence identifies the named kernel path.
Run operation tests sequentially through scripts/run_safe_pytest.sh.
Record skips and xfails separately; do not count them as passes.
Revalidate discovery-only routes after test or factory routing changes.

The newly inventoried TT-Train families use C++ operation tests and were not built or run during this static documentation reconciliation.
